title: Cluster validation for a hierarchical topic taxonomy of AI research
description:
Reference implementation of the two large-language-model validation protocols used to assess a hierarchical topic taxonomy of artificial-intelligence research derived from 1,986,659 OpenAlex records (2020-2025).

Document intrusion detection, adapted from the "reading tea leaves" paradigm of Chang et al. (2009): a panel of genuine cluster members is presented to a language model together with one intruder drawn from a different cluster at the same hierarchy level, and detection accuracy is taken as the coherence signal.

Coherence rating, following Tan and D'Souza (2025): a sample of documents from a single cluster is rated on a five-point Likert scale.

The repository contains the protocol implementation, the archived transcripts of all runs, and the manuscript sources. The 20 GB labelled corpus is not redistributed here; see data/README.md for how to reconstruct it from OpenAlex.
